limits: These calls do not benchmark expensive eth_call, historical state, indexer queries, inventory providers, gateway queuing, or browser scheduling.
Measurements originate on the host. The production VM and browser have separate network and queuing paths.
Sequential latest-head comparisons include new block production between requests. Same-height hash parity was checked separately.
Host filesystem utilization is measured at /srv, not asserted as the Nitro data-volume utilization.
Edge summaries include all gateway requests present in the window, including concurrent production activity and these probes.
interpretation.result: Local Nitro and authenticated tunnel were responsive for the three lightweight methods measured, without RPC/HTTP errors or edge rate limiting during this window.

methodology.httpClient: Python urllib; fresh connection per call, standard TLS validation, no proxy, no retries
methodology.location: RPC host; local loopback versus public authenticated Cloudflare tunnel
methodology.secretHandling: Credential read into memory from host private config; URL/token omitted from report
